name: tekhorizons
description: Tek Horizons site, served by GitHub Pages

scripts.css: sass --no-source-map scss/agency.scss css/agency.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/agency.scss css/agency.min.css
scripts.vendor: rm -rf vendor && mkdir -p vendor/bootstrap/css vendor/bootstrap/js vendor/fontawesome/css && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css vendor/bootstrap/css/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js vendor/bootstrap/js/ && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css vendor/fontawesome/css/ && cp -r node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts vendor/fontawesome/ && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/LICENSE.txt vendor/fontawesome/
scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run css
